_comment: MCPShield secure MCP client configuration template (Claude Desktop / Cursor / Claude Code .mcp.json format).
_guidance: Pin every package to an exact, reviewed version (never @latest).
Reference secrets from the environment (${VAR}); never write literal tokens into this file.
Scope filesystem access to the project directory only.
Run local servers behind 'mcpshield proxy' so tool definitions are vetted and calls are policy-checked and audited.
Prefer Streamable HTTP over HTTPS with OAuth 2.1 for remote servers; never plain http:// off-host.
